summary: Iteration 3 frontend-only verification of (a) receival-list filter/search persistence across reload and back navigation, and (b) mobile responsiveness at 390x844. All targeted behaviours PASS.

tests_executed.name: Filter persistence on RELOAD
tests_executed.details: Opened Filters, set Dispute=Yes, Recorded=No, search='TEST_QUERY'. localStorage 'eurasia_receival_filters' was written with {search:'TEST_QUERY', showFilters:true, filters:{dispute:'true', recorded:'false', ...}}. After page.reload(), filter panel was still open and Dispute='Yes', Recorded='No', search='TEST_QUERY' retained.

tests_executed.name: Filter persistence on BACK navigation (back-btn)
tests_executed.details: With Dispute=No and empty search on a list of 3 records (1 visible), clicked view-<id>, navigated to /receival/<id>, clicked data-testid=back-btn, returned to '/'. Filter panel still open; Dispute='No', Recorded='All', search='' identical to pre-nav state.

tests_executed.name: Filter persistence on BROWSER back
tests_executed.details: Repeated navigation using page.go_back(); Dispute filter preserved as 'No'.

tests_executed.name: Reset filters + persistence of cleared state
tests_executed.details: Reset button set Dispute=All, Recorded=All (and other filters to 'all'/empty). localStorage updated accordingly. After reload the cleared state (All/All) persisted.

tests_executed.name: Mobile viewport 390x844 — no horizontal overflow
tests_executed.details: Checked document.scrollWidth vs window.innerWidth on: receival list (390/390), /new (390/390), /settings (390/390), receival detail (checked, no overflowing elements). No elements caused overflow.

tests_executed.name: Settings 4-tab bar fits on mobile
tests_executed.details: TabsList width=358px, right=374px within innerWidth=390 — fits comfortably.

tests_executed.name: Mobile bottom nav visible & functional
tests_executed.details: nav-receivals-mobile, nav-new-mobile, nav-settings-mobile, logout-btn-mobile all visible on 390px viewport; nav-new-mobile navigated to /new and nav-settings-mobile navigated to /settings correctly.

critical_code_review_comments: ReceivalListPage.js persistence implementation is correct: state initializes from loadStored() and a useEffect writes to localStorage on [search, showFilters, filters] changes — this cleanly covers both reload and back-navigation cases (since remount re-reads localStorage).
Consider debouncing the localStorage write on search input to avoid a write per keystroke (minor, not blocking).
seed_data_creation: None; used existing 3 records in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Filter persistence key is 'eurasia_receival_filters' (distinct from 'eurasia_token'). Radix Select trigger text reads 'Yes'/'No'/'All' via inner_text. There are currently 3 receival records in the DB. All iteration-3 requirements verified passing.
